# MIKE IO: input/output of MIKE files in Python

*Suspiciously more than input/output.*

 ![Python version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/mikeio.svg)
[![PyPI version](https://badge.fury.io/py/mikeio.svg)](https://badge.fury.io/py/mikeio)


::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
## {{< fa clock >}} **Set up in 5 minutes**

Install **MIKE IO** with [`pip`](https://pypi.org/project/mikeio/) and get up
and running in minutes


[**Getting started**](user-guide/getting-started.qmd)

## {{< fa brands python >}} **It's just Python**

Read, write and manipulate dfs{0,1,2,3,u} and mesh files, and the PFS
setup files (.m21fm, .m3fm, …) that drive MIKE models.

[**API Reference**](api/index.qmd)

:::

::: {.g-col-6}

## {{< fa solid diagram-project >}} **Related packages**

[**MIKE IO 1D**](https://dhi.github.io/mikeio1d/) for .res1d and .xns11 files.

[**ModelSkill**](https://dhi.github.io/modelskill/) to compare model results
with observations.
